notes: Census burden covers Canada, all 10 provinces and 3 territories, and the 2021 table's metropolitan areas and agglomerations.
CHS core housing need excludes the territories; Canada (provinces only) is not all of Canada. Named metropolitan areas only; provincial urban/rural aggregates are excluded.
Rent and vacancy have separate source-supported geographies; absence of an area or a year is not zero. Suppressed and unavailable cells remain null with source status.
Burden, core housing need, rent and vacancy have different populations and reference periods. No interpolation, Canadian forecasts or pooled Canada/US burden comparison.
46-10-0084-01 was inspected and excluded: it contains dwelling, satisfaction and moving indicators, not shelter-cost burden. 46-10-0067-01 lacks a renter-tenure dimension.

measures.notes: Published percentages to one decimal, from the same comparison table in The Daily. Canada, all 13 provinces/territories and named metropolitan areas. Shelter costs are for the Census year; income is for the preceding year. This 2022 release can differ from later detailed-table revisions and count-based reconstruction; do not splice the two series. No annual interpolation or sampling intervals are supplied. Pandemic income support affects the 2020 income comparison.
measures.title: Renter burden, 2016–2021 comparison
measures.universe: Renter households in non-farm, off-reserve private dwellings with positive income; Census 2016 and 2021, common 2021 boundaries

measures.notes: 2021 housing costs / 2020 before-tax household income. Denominator is published under-30% plus 30%-or-more renter counts; excludes not applicable. Published count bounds and quality flags retained; a ratio confidence interval is not available and is not synthesized. Census counts are rounded.
measures.title: Renters spending 30% or more on shelter
measures.universe: Renter households with positive income in off-reserve, non-farm private dwellings; 2021 Census 25% sample

measures.notes: Not a burden rate. Assesses adequacy, suitability, affordability and cost of acceptable alternative local housing. Excludes nonpositive incomes and shelter-cost-to-income ratios >=100%; student household rules apply. Published 95% confidence intervals retained. 2021 Census geographic boundaries.
measures.title: Renters in core housing need
measures.universe: CHS renter households assessed for core housing need; provinces only

measures.notes: Nominal Canadian dollars, existing rental stock, not asking rent or renter household shelter costs. Changes can reflect dwelling composition. Geographic definitions change every five years; no constant-boundary growth estimate.
measures.title: Two-bedroom average monthly rent
measures.universe: CMHC privately initiated row and apartment structures with three or more units in surveyed areas of 10,000+ population

measures.notes: Vacancy uses all bedroom sizes and is context for two-bedroom rents; not an identical bedroom universe. Geographic definitions change every five years.
measures.title: Rental vacancy rate
measures.universe: CMHC privately initiated row and apartment structures with three or more units; all bedroom sizes; surveyed CMAs and CAs of 50,000+
